multiagent.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
multiagent.description: Claude handles backend, GPT handles frontend, Gemini runs tests — all simultaneously. Track each agent's progress in real-time on the kanban board.
multiagent.detail:
Marblo's multi-agent system maximizes each AI model's strengths.

Claude handles sophisticated backend logic and architecture design, GPT delivers rapid frontend coding and UI implementation, and Gemini manages test writing and code review.

Each agent runs in its own isolated terminal, and you can monitor progress in real-time on the kanban board. Through the MCP protocol, agents share context with each other, collaborating like a real development team.

kanban.title: Kanban Board + Agent Integration
kanban.description: Create tasks and agents automatically pick them up, coding in their own terminals. Todo → In Progress → Done — agents handle the flow.
kanban.detail:
Marblo's kanban board manages agent work through a 5-stage state machine: TODO → CLAIMED → IN_PROGRESS → REVIEW → DONE.

When you create a task, it's automatically assigned to the right agent based on role (backend/frontend/test/DevOps). Each agent codes independently in its own terminal, with progress reflected on the kanban board in real-time.

Set up task dependencies (depends_on) to automatically queue tasks until prerequisites are completed.

flow.title: Mission Editor
flow.description: Design Mission pipelines visually with a node-based editor. Automate workflows from code generation → review → testing → deployment. (Successor to the Flow editor.)
flow.detail:
A visual editor for designing Mission pipelines with drag and drop. Marblo evolved from simple Flow automation to a Mission supervisor — give it a goal, and Marblo breaks down, executes, and tracks progress.

Node types include agent execution, conditional branching, parallel processing, code review, and test execution. Connect them to build complex automation workflows without writing code.

For example, create a pipeline like 'Code Generation → Lint Check → Test Execution → Create PR on Pass' with just a few clicks. Save Mission templates for repeated use across projects.

orchestrator.title: Mission Launch (Natural Language)
orchestrator.description: Say "Add login to this app" and Marblo auto-decomposes the Mission, distributing tasks across agents. Cursor is one assistant; Marblo is a manager plus a fleet.
orchestrator.detail:
Give Marblo a goal in natural language and the AI manager decomposes the Mission and distributes tasks to the right agents.

Type "Add login to this app" and it breaks down into: 1) Backend auth API, 2) Frontend login form, 3) JWT token middleware, 4) Integration tests — four tasks assigned to separate agents.

Agents analyze the codebase to write code that fits existing architecture, detecting dependencies to execute in the correct order.

mcp.title: Native MCP Protocol
mcp.description: Equip agents with file system access, databases, APIs, and more via Model Context Protocol. Agents work in your real development environment.
mcp.detail:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a standard protocol that provides agents with real development tools and context.

Marblo natively supports MCP, allowing agents to read/write files, query databases, call REST APIs, run Git commands, and more — all in your actual development environment.

Extend agent capabilities by adding custom MCP servers. For example, connect the Marblo MCP server to let agents automatically update task progress on the board.

privacy.title: Local Execution — Your Data Stays on Your Machine
privacy.description: Your code never leaves your machine. The Electron app runs locally — you only configure your own API keys. Meets enterprise security requirements.
privacy.detail:
Marblo is an Electron-based desktop app where all code and data is processed exclusively on your local machine.

Your code is never sent to Marblo servers. AI API calls go directly to each model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) using API keys you configure.

Safe for enterprise environments, with on-premise deployment options for enhanced security. Audit logs and SSO authentication are available on the Enterprise plan.
